data.name: VibeUE.MaterialService
data.description:
Material service exposed directly to Python.

Provides material management actions NOT covered by Epic's native
MaterialTools / MaterialInstanceTools:

Lifecycle:
- save: Save material to disk
- compile: Compile/rebuild material shaders
- refresh_editor: Refresh open Material Editor
- open: Open material in editor

Information:
- get_info: Get comprehensive material information
- summarize: Get AI-friendly material summary
- list_parameters: List all material parameters
- get_property_info: Get detailed property metadata

Property Management:
- set_property: Set a single property value
- set_properties: Set multiple properties at once

Bulk Instance Parameters:
- set_instance_parameters_bulk: Set many instance params in one call

Existence Checks:
- material_exists / material_instance_exists / parameter_exists

@note This replaces the JSON-based manage_material MCP tool

tools.description:
Get an AI-friendly summary of a material.
Maps to action="summarize"
tools.name: VibeUE.MaterialService.Summarize

tools.description:
Set a material property value.
Maps to action="set_property"
tools.name: VibeUE.MaterialService.SetProperty

tools.description:
Set multiple material properties at once.
Maps to action="set_properties"
tools.name: VibeUE.MaterialService.SetProperties

properties.description: Map of property names to values

tools.description:
Set multiple parameters on a material instance in one call.
Maps to action="set_instance_parameters_bulk"

Supports Scalar, Vector, Texture, and StaticSwitch parameter types.
Much more efficient than calling individual set methods for instances
with many parameters (e.g., Real_Landscape master materials with 50+ params).
tools.name: VibeUE.MaterialService.SetInstanceParametersBulk

instancePath.description: Full path to the material instance

values.description: Array of values as strings. For Scalar: "0.5". For Vector: "(R=1,G=0,B=0,A=1)". For Texture: "/Game/Textures/T_Tex". For StaticSwitch: "true"/"false".

returnValue.description: Number of parameters successfully set Example: count = unreal.MaterialService.set_instance_parameters_bulk( "/Game/Materials/MI_Landscape", ["Tiling", "BaseColor", "DiffuseTexture", "UseSnow"], ["Scalar", "Vector", "Texture", "StaticSwitch"], ["0.01", "(R=0.2,G=0.5,B=0.1,A=1)", "/Game/T_Grass_BC", "true"]

tools.description:
Save a material to disk.
Maps to action="save"
tools.name: VibeUE.MaterialService.SaveMaterial

tools.description:
Refresh an open Material Editor to show latest property values.
Maps to action="refresh_editor"
tools.name: VibeUE.MaterialService.RefreshEditor

tools.description: Check if a parameter exists in a material.
tools.name: VibeUE.MaterialService.ParameterExists

returnValue.description: True if parameter exists Example: if not unreal.MaterialService.parameter_exists("/Game/Materials/M_Base", "BaseColor"): # Add the parameter node

tools.description:
Open a material in the Material Editor.
Maps to action="open"
tools.name: VibeUE.MaterialService.OpenInEditor

materialPath.description: Full path to the material or instance

tools.description: Check if a material instance exists at the given path.
tools.name: VibeUE.MaterialService.MaterialInstanceExists

instancePath.description: Full path to the material instance

returnValue.description: True if material instance exists Example: if not unreal.MaterialService.material_instance_exists("/Game/Materials/MI_Red"): unreal.MaterialService.create_instance("/Game/Materials/M_Base", "MI_Red", "/Game/Materials")

tools.description: Check if a material exists at the given path.
tools.name: VibeUE.MaterialService.MaterialExists

returnValue.description: True if material exists Example: if not unreal.MaterialService.material_exists("/Game/Materials/M_Base"): unreal.MaterialService.create_material("M_Base", "/Game/Materials")
